title: Dataclasses and __post_init__: Auto-Generated Boilerplate with Invariant Checks
description: @dataclass generates __init__, __repr__, __eq__. __post_init__ validates invariants at construction time, ensuring objects cannot exist in invalid states.

steps.description: Token is a dataclass with kind, value, line, col. __post_init__ validates kind and strips whitespace from value.
NumNode coerces value to float in __post_init__. BinOpNode validates op is +, -, *, or /.
Symbol is a frozen dataclass (immutable) with name. __post_init__ checks that name is a valid identifier.
Token demonstrations: __repr__ is auto-generated, __eq__ checks all fields, __post_init__ stripped spaces from value.
AST node demonstration: BinOpNode with NumNode children, showing auto-generated __repr__ and field access.
Symbol demonstration: frozen instances can be compared, hashed, and used as dict keys.
Running prints token repr, equality, stripped value, AST node, symbol hash/equality, and ValueError exceptions for invalid inputs.
